abstract: In a few short weeks, it is hard to believe that we will be ending yet another year. This is the first year of our new three-year strategic plan, which was approved by the Board of Governors in October 2018 after two years of discussion and planning effort. As I wrote in my column from earlier this year, this plan is designed to focus the Society on a sustainable future.
